description: Gene-eligibility parameters of the 20-gene classifier's gene ranking, set before any classifier outcome was computed. They control minimum representation, not EC biology.

parameter_meaning.minimum_cells_per_unit_class: cells a donor or sample needs in a class (EC or other terminal EEC) for its class mean to enter the gene ranking
parameter_meaning.training_detection_floor: share of a training study's cells that must detect a gene for that study to count toward the gene's eligibility
parameter_meaning.minimum_training_families: training studies that must pass the detection floor for a gene to be eligible
